label: First-Class National Housing Bond coupon rate
appliesTo: Anyone required to buy First-Class National Housing Bonds on a property registration
why: The bond runs five years at this rate. When market yields sit well above it, a buyer selling the bond the same day takes the gap as a loss — which is why the immediate-sale discount exists at all and why it moves. Before August 2012 the rate was 3.00%.

history.source: Korea Housing and Urban Guarantee / Housing and Urban Fund
history.note: Down from 3.00%, which had applied until 31 July 2012.
The rate in force now. Five-year maturity, repaid in a single sum.
